answer: A new account plants a juniper seedling that only grows when the owner completes one small public task a week for six weeks, so a farm must keep hundreds of slow hedges alive. Each week a gale of random timing blows: a falcon patrol of three unrelated veterans is dispatched to a random hedge and asks its owner one live question about the task just done, with minutes to answer in person. Miss twice and the hedge withers. Veterans who vouch for a fake hedge lose their patrol wings, so the patrol stays honest, while a real person just tends one garden and answers a neighbour.
